ml_job_overview.summary: The Medical Recs Coding & Transc. Senior Rep at NTT1GLOBAL392223EXTERNALENGLOBAL is responsible for transforming healthcare diagnoses, procedures, and medical services into universal medical alphanumeric codes. This role ensures uniform documentation across medical facilities by reviewing clinical statements and assigning standard codes. The position requires a strong understanding of human anatomy and physiology, as well as proficiency in computer applications. The successful candidate will play a vital part in supporting healthcare accuracy and efficiency. The role may require flexibility in shift timings and occasional overtime or weekend work as per business needs.
skills: Good knowledge in human anatomy and physiology is essential.
Experience using a computer with Windows PC applications, including keyboard navigation and learning new software tools, is required.
Ability to communicate effectively in English for information exchange with clients is necessary.
responsibilities: Responsible for reading documentation to understand patient diagnoses assigned.
Take ownership of transforming healthcare diagnoses, procedures, medical services, and equipment into universal medical alphanumeric codes.
Deliver high-quality uniform vocabulary for describing the causes of injury, illness, and death.
Review clinical statements and assign standard codes to ensure accurate documentation.
education: A university degree or equivalent is required.
Three or more years of formal studies in Life Science, BPT, Pharmacy, or Nursing is required.

job.ai_summary: The Medical Recs Coding & Transc. Senior Rep is responsible for interpreting patient diagnoses, transforming healthcare documentation into universal medical codes, and ensuring consistent documentation across medical facilities. The role requires reviewing clinical statements, assigning standard codes, and maintaining a uniform vocabulary for describing causes of injury, illness, and death. Candidates must have 0–1 year of experience in a healthcare BPO, a university degree or equivalent with 3+ years in life sciences, BPT, pharmacy, or nursing, and good knowledge of human anatomy and physiology. Proficiency with Windows PC applications, effective English communication skills, and flexibility for scheduled and occasional overtime are essential. The position operates Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM IST, with shift changes as per client needs.
job.primarySKill: BPO-Application Support-Medical Records Coding and Transcripting
job.posDutes:
In this Role you will be Responsible For : 

  • The coder reads the documentation to understand the patient's diagnoses assigned
  • Transforming of healthcare diagnosis, procedures, medical services, and equipment into universal medical alphanumeric codes
  • Creating uniform vocabulary for describing the causes of injury, illness & death is the role of medical coders
  • Medical coding allows for Uniform documentation between medical facilities
  • The main task of a medical coders is to review clinical statements and assign standard Codes

Requirements of the role include:

  • 0 -1 Year of experience in any Healthcare BPO
  • University degree or equivalent that required 3+ years of formal studies in Life science/BPT/Pharm/Nursing
  • Good knowledge in human Anatomy/Physiology
  • 1+ year(s) of experience using a computer with Windows PC applications that required you to use a keyboard, navigate screens, and learn new software tools
  • Ability to work scheduled shifts from Monday-Friday 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM IST and the shift timings can be changed as per client requirements.
  • Flexibility to accommodate overtime and work on weekend’s basis business requirement.
  • Ability to communicate (oral/written) effectively in English to exchange information with our client
